name: Carousel creator
pitch: Turn a course outline into a twelve-post educational carousel series for social media.
instructions: Read the course outline file. Break the outline into twelve logical post topics. Write each post as a short, standalone educational point. Format each post for a carousel: a hook sentence, 3 bullet points of key info, and a summary sentence. Save each post as a separate text file in the output folder. Offer to show the person the files so they can review before posting.
readme:
# Carousel creator
Turns a course outline into a twelve-post educational carousel series.

What it does: reads an outline file, splits the content into twelve topics, writes each as a hook-plus-bullets post, and saves the files.

What it needs: a course outline file in the workspace.

What it will not do: it cannot design graphics, write captions, or post to social media.
